text: I received excellent news and felt extremely happy.
My friends surprised me with a wonderful birthday celebration.
I was very sad when my close friend moved away.
I felt terrible after hearing the disappointing news.
I became angry when someone treated me unfairly.
I was furious because my colleague blamed me for something I did not do.
I was afraid to walk alone in the dark.
I felt scared when I heard a strange noise at night.
I was surprised when I unexpectedly won the competition.
The unexpected announcement shocked everyone in the room.
I felt disgusted after seeing the dirty and rotten food.
The smell from the garbage made me feel sick and disgusted.
